## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes (including browser integration & E2E tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm pack --dry-run` succeed
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/` and `README.md`) if CLI flags, config schema, or SDK APIs changed
- [ ] Browser capability limitations are accurately documented and tested
